[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text admin_label=”Paragraph” _builder_version=”4.27.4″ text_font=”Lato|700|||||||” text_font_size=”18px” text_line_height=”1.9em” header_font=”||||||||” header_3_font=”Lato|700|||||||” header_3_font_size=”40px” custom_margin=”|||” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

At Elite Disposal LLC, our junk removal service is built to help you reclaim your space without the stress. Whether you’re clearing out a garage, preparing a rental property, downsizing, or cleaning up after a renovation, we handle all the heavy lifting, hauling, and disposal so you don’t have to. From single-item pickups to full property cleanouts, our experienced crew works quickly and carefully to get the job done right.

We serve homeowners, property managers, contractors, and businesses with fast, professional junk removal tailored to your needs. Our team arrives on time, provides upfront pricing, and gets to work efficiently—removing everything from old appliances and furniture to yard debris, construction waste, and general clutter. We take pride in leaving every space cleaner, safer, and ready for whatever’s next.

No dumpsters, no delays, no guesswork—just honest service from a company that treats you like family. With flexible scheduling and a commitment to doing things the right way, it’s no wonder so many of our customers call us back time and time again.

When you need junk removed quickly, safely, and without the hassle, Elite Disposal LLC is the local name you can trust.
